IVS_ENTRY
       Namespace IVS_ENTRY

DESCRIPTION
       Entrypoint to Internal Virtual Server (IVS) for "sideband" processing. Receives requests or responses from an IVS client
       filter on a parent virtual server, and returns possibly modified versions of the request of response, returns a response to
       a request.

       Typically the IVS client is an ADAPT filter on the client (request) or server (response) side of the parent virtual server,
       and the IVS has an ICAP filter which encapsulates HTTP reqeusts or responses in ICAP requests for a remote ICAP server,
       then receives ICAP repsonses and unpacks them for ADAPT.

HINTS
SEE ALSO
BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
